hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.reselect_distance: median over the 9 generator.camera_track.CHECK_GRID points, in metres
hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.reselect_reference: arm R's mapping-space RTS smoothing of the current series (generator.camera_track.smooth_homographies mode='mapping')
hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.admissibility: the shipped gate, unchanged: error_m <= 2.0 AND generator.postprocess.onpitch_plausible against that frame's own detected foot points
hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.batch_parameterisation: pitch coordinates of the fixed CHECK_GRID per frame (18 unknowns/frame); never decomposed camera parameters
hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.batch_robust_weight: Cauchy w = 1/(1+(d/s)^2), s = max(median over frames of the grid spread of that frame's admissible hypotheses, 0.05) m
hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.batch_smoothness: second-difference penalty, lambda_j = (meas_sd_j/accel_sd_j)^2 from generator.camera_track._noise_estimates of the picked series -- dial-free, not fitted to any score
hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.clamp_m: INFINITE (no clamp). W5 measured the 2024-winner +-2 m clamp as HARMFUL to the batch arm: it blocks the rescue of catastrophically bad solves.
hyperparameters_verbatim_from_w5.applies_to: solved frames only; dead frames keep fill_calibration_gaps

pre_declared_gate.split: valid TEST-38 (the 38 sequences held out of DEV-20 in the local 58-sequence split)
pre_declared_gate.comparison: the v10 bundle (v9 chain + arm D on the s4 candidate cache) against the WITHIN-CACHE control (the same freeze cache's own gate pick, run through the identical chain), paired per sequence, flags ON.
pre_declared_gate.why_within_cache: the on-record TEST-38 lineage was extracted on 2026-08-06 from a different run of the same stack. Pairing against it would confound the arm with extraction drift. The within-cache control removes that; its drift versus the on-record number is reported separately as information, not as a bar.
pre_declared_failure_path: 1. If the bundle FAILS, drop s4 and re-gate arm D alone against the same within-cache control -- ONCE. Arm D alone is built on TEST-38 in the same window, so this costs no new decision freedom.
2. If arm D alone also fails, NOTHING SHIPS: no test-49 run, no package, and the v10 geometry axis is reported as DEV-only.
3. No third re-gate, no bar is moved, no sequence is dropped.
pre_declared_gate.test49: ONE chain run of whatever passes, then package. test-49 is untouched until the TEST-38 gate returns PASS.
